notes:
ZND-1e kicker slice, the SPELL-ON-STACK arm (CR 608.2 judges the effect,
the CAST row remembers the kick). Into the Roil {1}{U}, kicker {1}{U}: the
compiled SpellAbility effect is Seq(MOVE_ZONE target nonland permanent -> its owner's
hand, Conditional(WAS_KICKED, DRAW 1 YOU, else=None)). Until 2026-10-27 the bounce
sentence was unparsed and silently missing; sets round S-2 (B11, KNOWLEDGE /162)
compiles it, so each copy now bounces one opponent creature (sheep_a, sheep_b ->
their owner's hand: opponent hand 0 + 2 = 2). Kicked copy: WAS_KICKED reads the spell's own CAST row while the
frame resolves -> hand +1. Un-kicked copy: the pred answers False and the
absent else arm is silent -> no draw (the pair of casts pins BOTH branches in
one world: hand 2 - 2 casts + 1 draw = 1). Mana: 10U - 4U (kicked total) -
2U (base total) = 4U: the kick is priced, never free, never guessed.
